item_categories.title: Attack
item_categories.about: Three separate boosts that add up: a drink (Demondrug or Mega Demondrug, the Mega one replaces the other), a seed or pill (Might Seed or Might Pill, only the higher counts; the Xu Wu set bonus Protein Fiend shares this slot) and Demon Powder. The Powercharm counts on top of all of them, as does a meal's attack. Best stack: Mega Demondrug + Might Seed + Demon Powder + Powercharm = +33.

item_categories.title: Defense
item_categories.about: The same pattern as attack: a drink (Armorskin or Mega Armorskin), a seed or pill (Adamant Seed or Adamant Pill), Hardshell Powder, and the Armorcharm on top.

item_categories.title: Healing
item_categories.about: Potions heal part at once and the rest over a few seconds. Max and Ancient Potions also raise the health gauge to its maximum for 15 minutes.

item_categories.title: Food and stamina
item_categories.about: Food raises the stamina (and for steaks the health) gauge. A Ration is also what the Portable BBQ Grill cooks a meal from: see Meals.

item_categories.title: Cures and climate
item_categories.about: Blight cures and the hot / cold area drinks. A Sizzling Meal skill makes the drinks unnecessary.

item_categories.title: Materials
item_categories.about: What the items above are made from: where to gather, retrieve, buy or carve each one, and what else it goes into.

about: A meal raises your health gauge by 50 and your stamina gauge to its maximum 150, adds attack, defense or elemental resistance, and gives meal skills. The boosts and the skills last until the meal runs out; eating again replaces the old meal and restarts the timer, and the timer stands still in camps, towns, the Grand Hub and the tent.

At the Portable BBQ Grill (from a Ration in the pouch, or at a tent) you pick a ration type and optionally one additional ingredient and one finishing touch. Each ingredient brings its own skill plus one random skill, so a grilled meal carries up to four. A meal invitation in a settlement or a Grand Hub Canteen voucher gives the bigger stat boosts and three fixed skills plus two random ones.
The optimizer counts a meal's attack after the percentage bonuses: the meal attack field under Conditions (+5 for an invitation or Canteen meal, +2 for grilled meat).
